'''Edorion Selorna''' is a noble of [[Tear]]{{ref/book|5|30}}, and one of the nobles who make up the majority of the officers of the [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Appearance ==
A plump, pink-cheeked man.{{ref/book|4|2}} A subtle, soft spoken man, Edorion is noted as being clean shaven, dark haired and lean, with a serious look except when smiling. When he first meets [[Rand al'Thor]], however, he is described as being plump.{{ref/book|5|30}}

== History ==
He is noted by [[Mat Cauthon]] for possessing uncommon good sense as well as intelligence.{{ref/book|6|5}} It is clear Mat has him marked out as a man for higher command. He has a love for the ladies.{{ref/book|5|30}}

== Activities ==
He is one of the young lords in the [[Stone of Tear]] playing cards with [[Mat Cauthon]] when the [[bubble of evil]] causes Mat's cards to come to life and attack Mat. He notices Mat becoming aggravated by [[Estean]]'s careless comments, and tries to steer the conversation topic away.{{ref/book|4|2}}

While out looking to find help for [[Cairhien]] when the [[Shaido]] attack, he finds Rand al'Thor with the rest of the [[Aiel]]. He makes a wager with Rand that he will not make it to Cairhien to stop the Shaido in seven days.{{ref/book|5|30}} Later he is part of the escort that greets Rand al'Thor when he enters Cairhien after the battle with the [[Shaido]], and he is no longer plump.{{ref/book|5|46}}

He later joins the [[Band of the Red Hand]] and travels to [[Murandy]] where King [[Roedran]] employs the Band to stay on the border. After the employment is completed, he sets off with a number of the Band's banners and finds Mat in [[Altara]].

He is present when Mat rescues [[Olver]] from two thugs who want to "break his peasant neck!" and is given the assignment of providing the boy with a hot meal and a bath.{{ref/book|6|5}}
